title.en: Indian economy during reforms: an assessment
title.kn: ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ: ಒಂದು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ

hook.en: Shops are full of goods and mobile phones are everywhere. But many farmers are still in distress. So, did the reforms succeed?
hook.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು ಸರಕುಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿವೆ, ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಫೋನ್. ಆದರೂ ಅನೇಕ ರೈತರು ಸಂಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾದವೇ?

objectives.en: Explain criticism of reforms for agriculture and industry

narration.en: Shops are full of goods and mobile phones are everywhere. But many farmers are still in distress. So, did the reforms succeed?
narration.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು ಸರಕುಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿವೆ, ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಫೋನ್. ಆದರೂ ಅನೇಕ ರೈತರು ಸಂಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾದವೇ?

body.en: After the reforms, GDP growth increased, led mainly by the service sector. Foreign direct investment and foreign institutional investment rose, and India built up large foreign exchange reserves. India became a successful exporter of auto parts, engineering goods, IT services and textiles, and rising prices were kept under control.
body.kn: ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳ ನಂತರ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಸೇವಾ ವಲಯದ ನೇತೃತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಿಡಿಪಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು. ವಿದೇಶಿ ನೇರ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದೇಶಿ ವಿನಿಮಯ ಮೀಸಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದವು. ಐಟಿ ಸೇವೆ, ವಾಹನ ಬಿಡಿಭಾಗ ರಫ್ತು ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.

narration.en: After the reforms, GDP growth increased, led mainly by the service sector. Foreign direct investment and foreign institutional investment rose, and India built up large foreign exchange reserves. India became a successful exporter of auto parts, engineering goods, IT services and textiles, and rising prices were kept under control.
narration.kn: ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳ ನಂತರ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಸೇವಾ ವಲಯದ ನೇತೃತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಿಡಿಪಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು. ವಿದೇಶಿ ನೇರ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದೇಶಿ ವಿನಿಮಯ ಮೀಸಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದವು. ಐಟಿ ಸೇವೆ, ವಾಹನ ಬಿಡಿಭಾಗ ರಫ್ತು ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.

title.en: On the board: Reforms: a balance sheet

say.en: Let us weigh the reforms. On one side, the achievements.
Faster GDP growth led by services, more FDI and large reserves, more exports.
On the other side: agriculture neglected, industry hit by imports, assets undervalued.
On 8 November 2016, 500 and 1,000 rupee notes were demonetised.

prompt.en: Sort each statement about the reform years: an achievement, or a criticism?
prompt.kn: ಸುಧಾರಣಾ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ: ಸಾಧನೆಯೇ ಅಥವಾ ಟೀಕೆಯೇ?

text.en: GDP growth rose, led by services
Foreign investment and foreign exchange reserves rose sharply
India became a big exporter of auto parts, engineering goods and IT services
Public investment in irrigation, power and roads for farming fell
Cutting fertiliser subsidies raised costs for small farmers
Growth did not create enough good jobs
Cheap imports hurt many small industries
PSU shares were said to be sold below their value

explanation.en: The reforms raised growth, investment and reserves, but critics point to neglect of agriculture, weak job growth and pressure on small industry.

body.en: Critics say agriculture was neglected: public investment in irrigation, power, roads and research fell, fertiliser subsidies were cut, and farmers faced cheap imports. Industry suffered from cheap imports and poor infrastructure, disinvestment undervalued assets, and lower tax rates did not raise revenue as hoped. On 8 November 2016 the government demonetised ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes to fight corruption, black money and counterfeit currency and to promote digital transactions.
body.kn: ಕೃಷಿಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಲಾಯಿತು ಎಂಬುದು ಟೀಕೆ: ನೀರಾವರಿ, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್, ರಸ್ತೆ, ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಯಿತು. 8 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2016ರಂದು ₹500 ಮತ್ತು ₹1000 ನೋಟುಗಳ ಅಮಾನ್ಯೀಕರಣ ಮಾಡಲಾಯಿತು.

points.en: Agriculture: lower public investment, subsidy cuts

narration.en: Critics say agriculture was neglected: public investment in irrigation, power, roads and research fell, fertiliser subsidies were cut, and farmers faced cheap imports. Industry suffered from cheap imports and poor infrastructure, disinvestment undervalued assets, and lower tax rates did not raise revenue as hoped. On 8 November 2016 the government demonetised ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes to fight corruption, black money and counterfeit currency and to promote digital transactions.

problem.en: Make a balanced 4-point appraisal of the reforms for a 4-mark answer.

steps.en: Point 1 (achievement): higher GDP growth, led by services.
Point 2 (achievement): more FDI and much larger foreign exchange reserves.
Point 3 (criticism): agriculture neglected through lower public investment and subsidy cuts.
Point 4 (criticism): industry hit by cheap imports and weak infrastructure; disinvestment undervalued assets.

answer.en: Two achievements and two criticisms, each with one line of reasoning, make a balanced answer.

narration.en: Recap. Reforms raised GDP growth, mainly through services, and increased FDI and reserves. Agriculture was neglected, and industry suffered from cheap imports and poor infrastructure. Demonetisation (8 November 2016) targeted black money and promoted digital payments.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು ಸೇವಾ ವಲಯದ ಮೂಲಕ ಜಿಡಿಪಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೀಸಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿದವು. ಕೃಷಿ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ; ಅಗ್ಗದ ಆಮದು ಮತ್ತು ದುರ್ಬಲ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆಗೆ ತೊಂದರೆ. ನೋಟು ಅಮಾನ್ಯೀಕರಣ (8 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2016) ಕಪ್ಪು ಹಣದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪಾವತಿಗಾಗಿ.
